Trellis M4 MIDI Drum Sequencer

Repository: https://github.com/thomasf/neotrellis-seq

Standalone 6-voice polyphonic USB-MIDI step sequencer for the Adafruit NeoTrellis M4 (SAMD51 Cortex-M4 at 120 MHz, 8×4 RGB elastomeric keypad). Features polymetric track lengths, 4-level velocity dynamics, generative algorithmic transforms, and 256-step undo/redo.

GitHub Repository Download Firmware (UF2) Issues & Discussions

Specifications & Architecture

FeatureDescription
Repositoryhttps://github.com/thomasf/neotrellis-seq
Firmwareneotrellis-seq.uf2 — prebuilt UF2 image (SAMD51 drag-and-drop flash)
Voices6 independent drum channels (Voice 0–5), mapped by default to General MIDI / Ableton Drum Rack (C1–D#2) on Channel 1.
Pattern Memory16 pattern slots per voice (96 total), switchable on the fly without interrupting playback.
Track LengthIndependent length per voice (1–16 steps) for evolving polymeters and phase meters.
Velocities4 expressive levels: Accent (127), Normal (99), Ghost / Muted (50), and Rest / Silence (0).
Undo / Redo256 edits deep across all voices. Swaps and all-voice transforms undo/redo in a single press.
TransformsAlgorithmic generators: Game of Life, Shift, Echo, Invert, Drift, Declutter, Fill Empty.
MIDI TransportClass-compliant USB-MIDI following host clock (24 PPQN), start, stop, continue, and SPP.

Step Action Modifier Held Voice Unassigned

Presses

PadActionDescription
STEP nToggle StepToggles the note on step n of the selected pattern.
VOICE vSelect VoiceSelects voice v for editing, and lights up while it fires.
COPYCopy PatternCopies the selected pattern to the paste buffer.
PASTEPaste PatternOverwrites the selected pattern with the paste buffer.
CLEARClear PatternZeroes every step of the selected pattern.
UNDOUndo / RedoSteps back through pattern edits (256 deep). Restores to original voice and slot. FN + UNDO redoes.
MENUMenu ModeEnters settings menu (Voice Protect, playback path modifiers, MIDI note assignment). Press MENU again to return to sequencer.

Held modifiers

CombinationActionDescription
ACCENT + STEP nAccent StepAccents step n (velocity 127). Toggles an accented step back to normal velocity (99); switches a silent step on accented.
ACCENT + CLEARClear AccentsRemoves all accents from the selected pattern, leaving notes in place.
LEN + STEP nSet LengthSets the selected pattern’s loop length to n steps.
POS + STEP nSet PositionMoves the selected voice’s playhead to step n.
POS + ALL + STEP nSet All PositionMoves every voice’s playhead to step n simultaneously.
POS + FNRewind TransportResets playback position of all voices to step 0 and arms them to fire on next step/clock (can also be pressed as FN + POS).
VOICE v + STEP nSelect PatternSelects pattern slot n for voice v without modifying step data. Multiple voice pads can be held at once.
ALL + STEP nSelect All PatternsSelects pattern slot n for all unprotected voices simultaneously (protected voices remain on their current slot).
FN + …Function (FN)Accesses secondary functions: pattern transforms, presets, voice swap, rewind, redo, and paste all (see below).
FN + ALL + …Function AllApplies functions across all unprotected voices simultaneously: all-voice transforms, kit presets, odd meters, and dropout (see below).

Function Key (FN)

The pad map while FN is held. Step pads apply an edit to the selected pattern, voice pads swap patterns with the selected voice, UNDO turns into redo and PASTE pastes into every pattern slot of the selected voice. ACCENT is a prefix: held as well, it changes what the step pads do. Holding ALL as well applies the step pads to every voice, see the next section. Every edit acts within the pattern length and leaves steps past it alone.

PadActionDescription
STEP 1, 2Shift ±1Shifts pattern left (STEP 1) or right (STEP 2) by 1 step, wrapping within length.
STEP 3, 4Shift ±4Shifts pattern left (STEP 3) or right (STEP 4) by 4 steps, wrapping within length.
STEP 5ReverseReverses the pattern within its active length.
STEP 6InvertInverts sounding and silent steps, keeping active pattern length.
STEP 8Fill EmptyAdds notes on steps where no other voice sounds, prioritizing least crowded steps.
STEP 9ShuffleRandomly shuffles step order within the active pattern length.
STEP 10EchoCopies each note 2 steps later at half velocity. Repeated presses add successive echoes.
STEP 11DriftMoves one note 1 step left or right onto a free step, preserving velocity.
ACCENT + STEP nLoad PresetLoads pattern preset n (1–16), incorporating accents, normal hits, and ghost notes.
POSRewindResets playback position of all voices to step 0 and arms them to fire on next step/clock.
VOICE vSwap PatternSwaps selected pattern with voice v’s current pattern.
UNDORedoRedoes the last undone edit. Subsequent new edits clear redo history.
PASTEPaste All SlotsOverwrites all 16 pattern slots of the selected voice with the paste buffer.

Function Key on all voices (FN + ALL)

The pad map while FN and ALL are both held. Applies transforms across all six voices simultaneously. Voices with Voice Protect enabled are shielded from all-voice transforms and retain their existing patterns and lengths. Evaluates voices in order, enabling generative interlocking variations across all drum tracks.

Menu Mode: Voice Protect & Playback Paths

Press MENU to enter settings. Voice pads 0–5 select the settings page for that voice (the active voice lights in white). The top-left button (STEP 1) toggles Voice Protect on and off. The second step row (STEP 5–8) toggles 4 independent, combinable Playback Path Modifiers. All toggles illuminate green (COLOR_GREEN) when active and red (COLOR_RED) when inactive. Hold any voice pad (VOICE 0–5) to reassign its MIDI note on the 16-step grid.

PadActionDescription
VOICE 0–5 (tap)Select Voice PageSelects which voice’s settings page is displayed. Active voice button lights in white. Voice buttons continue to flash in sync with playback (inverted: turning off briefly instead of turning white when a note plays).
Hold VOICE 0–5Voice MenuHold a voice pad (or tap a step while holding) to enter the Voice Menu and reassign its MIDI note on the 4×4 drum rack grid. Release to return.
STEP 1 (Row 1)Toggle Voice ProtectProtects the voice from all global actions (ALL and FN + ALL transforms, kits, and length changes). Its pattern stays untouched unless edited directly.
STEP 5 (Row 2)Ping-Pong PathForward-then-reverse bounce without repeating ends (e.g. 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 2 → 1). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
STEP 6 (Row 2)Spiral PathOutside-in clockwise grid traversal (0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 11, 15, 14, 13, 12, 8, 4, 5, 6, 10, 9). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
STEP 7 (Row 2)Phase Slip PathRotational phase slip (+1 step offset each completed cycle, staggered by +2 steps per voice). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
STEP 8 (Row 2)Mutate PathRandomly switches between all unused path modifiers every 4 bars (Stutter, Weave, Drunken, Beat Ping-Pong, Broken Thirds, Downbeat Lock, Pair Swap, Turnaround, Pedal). Lights green when active, red when inactive.
MENUExit MenuExits Menu Mode and returns to the sequencer.

Menu Mode: Voice Menu (MIDI Note Assignment)

Holding any VOICE pad for ≥ 200ms in Menu Mode (or holding a voice pad and tapping a step pad) enters Voice Menu Mode. The 4×4 step grid mirrors the 16-pad Ableton Drum Rack (notes 36–51, bottom row 36–39 to top row 48–51). The currently assigned pad for the active voice illuminates in white (COLOR_PPOS). Pads assigned to other voices illuminate in their respective voice colors. Available / unassigned pads are dark. Tap any step pad (1–16) to reassign or swap notes. Tap another voice pad to switch the voice being edited. Release the held voice pad to return to Menu Mode, or tap MENU to exit directly back to the sequencer.
